job.job_description:
Strong full-stack engineer who can build AI-enabled web applications end to end  from frontend experience through backend APIs, data flows, model integration, deployment and support.
Comfortable working across:
Frontend: JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Next.js, HTML, CSS
Backend: Python, FastAPI / Flask, Node.js / Express
AI integration: OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, LangChain / LlamaIndex, vector search, embeddings, RAG pipelines
Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, object storage, APIs, structured and unstructured data
Cloud & DevOps: Azure / AWS, Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
Build modern web applications with clean, responsive, usable interfaces.
Develop backend services and APIs in Python and/or Node.js.
Integrate AI models into real business workflows, not just demos.
Build features such as:
Chat interfaces
Document upload and analysis
Semantic search
Retrieval Augmented Generation — RAG
Workflow automation
AI agents / tool-calling flows
Data extraction and summarisation
Design and implement secure API layers between frontend, backend, AI services and databases.
Work with vector databases and embedding models to support knowledge search and contextual AI responses.
Handle file processing for PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets, images and structured datasets.
Create reusable components, services and utilities that other teams can build on.
Support deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting and performance tuning.
